name: Hood Wars 💥
desc:
💥 Step into the vibrant streets of the Hood War, where the rhythm of the city never sleeps. Become a resident of this iconic borough, connecting with a group of locals as you navigate through challenges to build your wealth, engage in trades, and immerse yourself in the pulse of urban life.

🎮CONSOLE SUPPORTED
🔫 WEAPONS
🏠 HOMES
📦 SAFE STORAGE
🚗 VEHICLES
💳 SWIPING 💳
💰BANK ROBBERY💰
AND MORE❗

CONTROLS:
R2 TO SHOOT
L2 TO SPRINT
B TO HANGOUT CAR PC
